title: kgdiff report, version 1
description: The payload of an HTML report, as the crate kgdiff-report (`report_payload`, `report_payload_with`) writes it and `<kgdiff-viewer>` reads it (its `payload` property, or a `<script type="application/kgdiff+json">` element): a diff, its layout or none, what the report says about itself and how the viewer starts. See https://github.com/iiwish/kgdiff/blob/main/docs/cli.md#html-report

version.description: Readers reject versions they do not support.

diff.description: The diff: packed (what kgdiff writes), or not.

layout.description: The layout of the diff: every position belongs to a union node of `diff`. With it, the report opens without computing anything. Left out, the viewer lays the diff out when it reads the payload, which needs its compute module.

title.description: The title of the report. Without it, the names of the two versions.

generatedAt.description: An ISO 8601 timestamp; left out of reproducible reports.

view.description: How the viewer starts; an attribute or a property set on the viewer wins. Later minor versions add optional members, so readers ignore the members they do not know and this schema allows them.

mode.description: `changes` appears only in reports made before scopes existed; the viewer no longer reads it as a mode, ignores it and uses `overlay`. Write `mode: overlay` with `scope: changes` instead.

scope.description: What is drawn: the whole graph, or the changes with some context.

panels.description: The initial state of regions of the default layout; the others keep theirs.

shapes.description: Node type to shape: a node takes the shape of the first entry, in this order, among its types (the after version's; the before version's for a removed node); with none, a circle. Experimental, and stays so after 1.0.

name.description: The name shown for this version.

format.description: The format the graph was read from, e.g. `turtle`.

layoutV1.description: A layout of version 1, as `layoutToJSON` of @kgdiff/layout writes the layouts it computes: the members of version 2 (layout.v2.json) without `generator`.
